title: AEGIS API v1.0.0 schemas
description: Generated from packages/contracts/src. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run generate`.

ActionName.description: Dotted action name "<resource>.<operation>" (2-5 lowercase segments), e.g. "crm.customers.export".

ActionPattern.description: Action matcher: "*", an exact action name, or a namespace prefix such as "crm.*". No other wildcards.

AgentId.description: Registered agent identity. A claim until matched against the authenticated credential.

AgentIdentity.description: Registered agent. Authenticated by a credential bound to agentId; model-generated self-descriptions are ignored.

displayName.description: Human-readable label. NEVER used for authorization or identity matching.

ApprovalRequest.description: Pending human authorization bound (via bindingDigest) to one tenant, agent, principal, action, resource and arguments digest. It can never authorize anything else, and is consumed on first use.

AttributeRef.description: Reference to an evaluation attribute. "request.context.*" is caller-supplied and untrusted.

AttributeScalar.description: String (<=1024 chars), finite number, boolean or null.

AttributeValue.description: Scalar or flat list of scalars. Nested objects are not permitted.

Attributes.description: Flat attribute map. Keys match ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$ (so "__proto__" and dotted keys are impossible); at most 64 entries.

AuditEvent.description: Append-only, hash-chained audit record. eventHash = sha256(canonical(event without eventHash)); previousEventHash links to the prior event of the same tenant (null only for sequence 0).

Condition.description: Boolean condition AST evaluated with three-valued (Kleene) logic. Missing or mistyped attributes yield UNKNOWN.

CreatePolicyRequest.description: Creates a policy or appends a new immutable version. Requires scope aegis:policies:write.

activate.description: Activate the new version atomically on creation.

expectedLatestVersion.description: Optimistic concurrency guard. null = the policy must not exist yet; N = the latest version must be N. Mismatch returns 409 CONFLICT.

CredentialRefId.description: Opaque stable identifier (letters, digits, ".", "_", ":", "-"; must start alphanumeric). Identifiers are compared byte-for-byte and are never interpreted.

CredentialReference.description: Pointer to a credential held by the enforcement point. Agents never receive the secret; the trusted tool adapter resolves it only after verifying an execution authorization.

locator.description: Where the secret lives (path/ARN). Never the secret value itself.

DelegatedAuthority.description: Server-managed grant from a principal to an agent. The effective authority of an agent is the intersection of its grants and tenant policy; grants never widen policy and policy never widens grants.

DelegationScope.description: Omit resourceIds to cover every resource of the type.

field.description: JSON Pointer to the offending field, when applicable.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Every non-2xx response uses this envelope. HTTP status and error.code are both normative.

code.description: One of ERROR_CODES; unknown codes must be treated as non-retryable.

message.description: Human-readable. Never contains secrets, stack traces or other tenants' data.

EvaluateDecisionRequest.description: Agent request for a decision. It carries no tenant, principal, role or permission: those are derived by the server from the verified credential and server-managed grants. `context` is caller-supplied and untrusted. `argumentsDigest` (optional in v1, REQUIRED by servers for tools that return execution authorizations) binds the decision to the exact tool arguments. `approvalId` resumes a previously approved request.

EvaluateDecisionResponse.description: A decision is advisory to the caller and authoritative only at an enforcement point. expiresAt bounds how long an ALLOW may be relied upon; it is never a reusable credential.

approvalId.description: Set when effect is REQUIRE_APPROVAL (the pending approval) or when an approval was consumed.

executionAuthorization.description: Present only when effect is ALLOW and the server issues execution artifacts for this action.

ExecutionAuthorization.description: Short-lived (<=300s), single-use, Ed25519-signed artifact that a trusted enforcement point verifies before executing exactly the bound action on exactly the bound resource with exactly the bound arguments digest. The bindings object is informational; enforcement MUST rely only on the verified token claims.

GrantId.description: Opaque stable identifier (letters, digits, ".", "_", ":", "-"; must start alphanumeric). Identifiers are compared byte-for-byte and are never interpreted.

HealthResponse.description: Unauthenticated liveness/readiness. MUST NOT reveal tenant data, dependency hostnames or versions of internals.

Identifier.description: Opaque stable identifier (letters, digits, ".", "_", ":", "-"; must start alphanumeric). Identifiers are compared byte-for-byte and are never interpreted.

tenantPolicyVersion.description: The tenant-wide policy set version string that decisions report as policyVersion.

PolicyDocument.description: Tenant policy document. It intentionally has no tenantId: the tenant is bound by the server from the authenticated administrator, never from the document.

PolicyId.description: Opaque stable identifier (letters, digits, ".", "_", ":", "-"; must start alphanumeric). Identifiers are compared byte-for-byte and are never interpreted.

PolicyRule.description: A rule applies when action, resource type, sensitivity, time window and condition all match. Precedence is by effect only: DENY > REQUIRE_APPROVAL > ALLOW. There are no numeric priorities.

Principal.description: Human or service principal. Attributes are server-managed (e.g. from the IdP), never caller-asserted.

displayName.description: Human-readable label. NEVER used for authorization or identity matching.

ReasonCode.description: Machine-readable reason. Unknown codes must be treated as opaque by clients.

ResolveApprovalRequest.description: The approver echoes the bindingDigest of the request they reviewed. The server rejects the resolution with 409 APPROVAL_BINDING_MISMATCH if it differs, so an approver can never approve something other than what they saw. Requires scope aegis:approvals:resolve; the requesting principal and the agent may not resolve their own approvals.

ResourceId.description: Opaque resource identifier; control characters are rejected.

ResourceRef.description: Target resource. Caller-supplied attributes are claims: the server MUST overwrite server-owned keys (see docs/security/integration-requirements.md) before evaluation.

Sensitivity.description: Ordered data classification: public < internal < confidential < restricted.

SensitivityRange.description: Matches resource.attributes.sensitivity. A missing or unrecognised value is treated as "restricted".

Sha256Digest.description: "sha256:" followed by lowercase hex SHA-256 of the AEGIS canonical JSON encoding (see canonicalization spec).

name.description: Human-readable label. NEVER used for authorization or identity matching.

TenantId.description: Tenant identifier. Never accepted from request bodies on authenticated routes; derived from the verified credential.

end.description: Exclusive local end "HH:MM" (or "24:00"); must be after start.

utcOffset.description: Fixed UTC offset. IANA zones are intentionally unsupported in v1 for deterministic evaluation.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC. Offsets other than "Z" are rejected.
